reason: I'm home with the kids all week and need somewhere clean and indoors to go, and the free first visit lets me try it with no risk. I'd pay for a couple of weekday visits, but not a membership until I see how it goes.
objection: Money is tight since daycare went up, and $13 a visit adds up fast. I'll also be chasing my kid, so I won't really get to sit and drink the coffee.
would_change_my_mind: A cheaper weekday price, or a 5-visit pack that works out closer to $10 a visit.
